title: [SEC2] ikm_buf allocated at full OKM_MAXLEN regardless of actual key size
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1785 allocates ikm_buf at CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_OKM_MAXLEN (64 bytes) unconditionally, but only copies and uses sk_src->len bytes (potentially 16-32 bytes for typical symmetric keys). This wastes 32-48 bytes per ikm_fd KDF call. Improvement: allocate exactly sk_src->len bytes after validating the source key.
close_reason: Review converged. SEC7: running out of real complaints. P0=0 P1=0. Efficiency findings .6/.9 are marginal (no correctness impact). DECISION records noted.
